claims.quote: Renewables reached 16.9% of Israel's electricity in 2025
claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015

SELECT 100.0 * ( (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025) - (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015) ) / (SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015)
claims.note: data says 791.57, report says 891; also inconsistent: the report's own figures 1.9 (2015) -> 16.9 (2025) give +15.0 percentage points, +789.5%, +24.43% per year compounded, but it states 891%
